rows.quote: Proteomic data comprised cis protein quantitative trait loci (cis‐pQTL) for 4907 plasma proteins from 35 559 participants from the Decode cohort [14].
rows.reference_quote: E. Ferkingstad , P. Sulem , B. A. Atlason , et al., “ Large‐Scale Integration of the Plasma Proteome With Genetics and Disease ,” Nature Genetics 53 , no. 12 ( 2021 ): 1712 – 1721 . 34857953 10.1038/s41588-021-00978-w
rows.coder_note: Sentence attributes the cis-pQTL data (4907 proteins, 35 559 participants) to reference 14, whose DOI is the source of one candidate row.
